about_the_game:
Take charge of an elite crew of intergalactic exterminators as they go on their most important bug hunt to save a garden planet. Manage their growth, learn the best combinations of their weapons, and stay one step ahead of the bugs however possible.

  • 12 Exterminators – choose from melee and ranged heroes, each with their own signature main weapon

  • Powerful abilities – unlock new special attacks for more tactical options

  • New builds every run – make strategic choices from the limited bonuses each level up to find a winning combination for the run.

  • Grow stronger – earn honor each run to improve the base abilities of your squad to face the growing swarm

  • Survive the swarm – use all your skill and abilities to survive when swarm waves put your squad to the test

Embark on a desperate mission to save a vibrant garden planet from an overwhelming insect infestation in Survive the Swarm. Command a squad of elite exterminators, each wielding unique weapons and abilities, against relentless waves of monstrous bugs. Strategic upgrades and tactical combat are crucial as both your team and the swarm evolve with each encounter.

Choose from twelve diverse exterminators, ranging from close-quarters brawlers to long-range specialists, and unlock powerful special attacks to turn the tide of battle. Every run offers fresh challenges and build possibilities, as you select from a limited array of bonuses to optimize your squad's effectiveness. Earn honor to permanently enhance your exterminators' base stats, ensuring they're prepared to face the ever-growing swarm in this intense test of survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or equivalent
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low graphics setting

short_description: Dodge, dash, and destroy bugs with your squad in a fight for survival of a beautiful garden planet. Choose from distinct heroic exterminators equipped with powerful weapons to fight the infestation. They will grow stronger on the job, and so will the bugs.
